summary: This bill amends the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act to require the Environmental Protection Agency to coordinate with the Department of Agriculture when developing pesticide risk mitigation measures, conducting economic analyses, and utilizing agricultural data, and to coordinate with the Departments of Agriculture, Interior, and Commerce on actions related to the Endangered Species Act.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Federal Insecticide, Fungicide, and Rodenticide Act (FIFRA) to improve coordination between the EPA and USDA regarding pesticide regulation. While it doesn't directly change environmental protection standards, it mandates economic analyses and increased consideration of agricultural impacts when implementing risk mitigation measures for pesticides, and also requires coordination with the Secretaries of Interior and Commerce regarding Endangered Species Act compliance. This could lead to a more balanced approach that considers both environmental protection and agricultural viability, potentially moderating the stringency of some environmental regulations related to pesticides.
